single_outlet_findings.finding: Only headline in the corpus to label AfD 'friends of Putin', explicitly embedding the German election result in Russia's geopolitical orbit — no other outlet's headline makes this linkage.

Only headline to quote Trump's 'Make Germany Great Again!' slogan verbatim and to note AfD's accusations of antisemitism and Holocaust distortion — uniquely foregrounding the slogan's resonance for a Jewish-majority readership.
Only headline to adopt a causal-analytical 'why...and what happens next' question frame, positioning the AfD win as a political puzzle to be explained rather than a shock to be reported.

bottom_line: The headline layer asserts a dual story: an unprecedented far-right breakthrough that puts Germany's postwar anti-extremism 'firewall' under its gravest test, amplified by Trump's 'Make Germany Great Again' endorsement that frames the result as part of a coordinated trans-Atlantic far-right surge.
